exact_fixed_graph_need: For every infinite finitely generated nonamenable group Gamma and every finite symmetric generating set S, its simple undirected Cayley graph G=Cay(Gamma,S) has p_c^bond(G)<p_u^bond(G). The analogous site formulation must be tracked separately.

original_source.title: Percolation beyond Z^d, many questions and a few answers
original_source.statement: Every connected locally finite almost-transitive graph with positive vertex Cheeger constant has p_c(G)<p_u(G).
original_source.model_note: Paper treats site percolation, and states nonplanar results/questions extend with minor modifications to bond percolation.

spectral_source.conclusion: Almost surely infinitely many infinite clusters; in particular rho(G)*k*p_c(G)<1 implies p_c<p_u.
